tellings.difference: Adds a prediction that this will be revealed in our lifetime, and does not name Cydonia.
tellings.link_reason: Alberino's claim of an ancient extraterrestrial civilisation on Mars, which he says was discussed earlier in the episode, matches his story of ruins of an ancient civilisation at Cydonia.

as_told.title: An ancient extraterrestrial civilisation on Mars will be revealed

plain: There are said to be ruins of an ancient civilization on Mars, in a region called Cydonia, left by an extraterrestrial people who once lived there. The filmmaker Tim Alberino says this, drawing on the researchers David Flynn, Richard Hoagland and Michael Heiser and his own film Birthright, and adds that he expects this truth about Mars to be revealed within our lifetime.
